description: This file defines a Java interface for customer attribute services, including method signatures for saving, updating, and retrieving customer attribute data related to merchant stores and customers.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeService
classes.description: A service interface for managing CustomerAttribute entities, providing methods to save, update, and retrieve customer attribute data.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on merchant store, customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on merchant store and attribute value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a given merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer in a merchant store.
